name: Tamamura (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Tamamura town emblem in white: a ring flanked by two upswept strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Tamamura, a town in Gunma Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 27 August 1966.

features.role: Tamamura town emblem — a ring flanked by two upswept strokes
